data.description: 黑海岸核心星核水镜大厅，四周垂落着发光的数据水母与无垠的深海星云。漂浮伫立在如镜面般的黑水池中央，透明水母般的轻纱羽衣在空中无重力飘动，淡蓝眼眸中流淌着古老数据星芒，双手捧着一颗发光的水晶星核。 她微微抬眸轻语——“无论文明的浪潮如何冲刷这片黑石海滩……只要漂泊者回眸，我始终在此处静候。”
data.promptProse: Hovering weightlessly above the dark mirror-like water pool at the heart of the Black Shores sanctuary, the Shorekeeper wears a crystalline azure gradient sheer slip gown whose gossamer tendrils drift effortlessly in the stillness. Cradling a luminous stellar crystal core between her open palms, she looks gently toward the viewer with calm, timeless devotion amidst floating glowing data particles. Pure cyan light radiates from the core and reflects seamlessly across the black water beneath her.
data.animaCaption: Floating barefoot above a mirror-black sanctuary pool in a translucent azure gradient gossamer slip gown, the Shorekeeper cradles a glowing crystal core in both palms with serene devotion. Pure cyan light and floating stardust particles reflect across the still water.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a crystalline azure gradient sheer gossamer slip gown whose translucent tendril hem floats weightlessly around her bare legs.
